mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate (over the past 3 months) signals an easing monetary cycle that compresses discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day returns in > 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS has declined over the past 3 months, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained unemployment rate above 10.0% signals labor market distress that increases risk aversion and reduces equity valuations, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in > 60% of instances where UNRATE > 10.0, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Joint increases in residential sales (RSAFS) and housing starts (HOUST) signal robust consumer demand that accelerates corporate revenue growth, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day returns in > 60% of instances where both RSAFS and HOUST have increased over the past month, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In a manufacturing contraction regime (INDPRO < 90.0), a decline in industrial production signals deteriorating economic activity that triggers equity sell-offs, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in > 60% of instances where INDPRO < 90.0, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in housing starts (HOUST) signals strong consumer demand that accelerates corporate revenue growth, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day returns in > 60% of instances where HOUST has increased over the past month, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When inflation (CPIAUCSL) rises above 255.0, it signals potential monetary tightening that increases discount rates and reduces equity valuations, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in > 60% of instances where CPIAUCSL > 255.0, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Joint increases in employment (PAYEMS) and industrial production (INDPRO) signal a strong labor market and robust manufacturing that boosts corporate earnings, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60-day returns in > 60% of instances where both PAYEMS and INDPRO have increased over the past month, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When inflation (CPIAUCSL) rises above 255.0, it signals potential monetary tightening that increases discount rates and reduces equity valuations, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5-day returns in > 60% of instances where CPIAUCSL > 255.0, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.
